title: Enrollment Charges, Paid-in-Full Pricing and the Monthly Billing Day
content:
**Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans — billing terms at enrollment.**

1. **Charges at enrollment.** Enrollment charges the plan's enrollment fee together with the first monthly fee. Where the customer enrolls with payment in full, the plan's paid-in-full price is charged in place of the monthly fee; the paid-in-full price is the price of the 12-month term when paid in full at enrollment or renewal.
2. **Term.** The plan term runs the plan's term length, in months, from the enrollment date.
3. **Billing day.** Monthly fees are charged on the same day of each month as the enrollment date; in a month that has no such day, the fee is charged on the last day of that shorter month.

## Fee schedule (USD)

| Plan | Enrollment fee | Monthly fee | Paid-in-full price | Term length |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Puppy Wellness Plan | 59.95 | 39.95 | 431.46 | 12 months |
| Kitten Wellness Plan | 59.95 | 34.95 | 377.46 | 12 months |
| Adult Dog Wellness Plan | 59.95 | 34.95 | 377.46 | 12 months |
| Adult Cat Wellness Plan | 59.95 | 29.95 | 323.46 | 12 months |
| Senior Dog Wellness Plan | 59.95 | 54.95 | 593.46 | 12 months |
| Senior Cat Wellness Plan | 59.95 | 49.95 | 539.46 | 12 months |

## Charges on the enrollment date, worked from the schedule

| Plan | Paying monthly | Paying in full |
|---|---|---|
| Puppy Wellness Plan | 59.95 and 39.95, total 99.90 | 59.95 and 431.46, total 491.41 |
| Adult Cat Wellness Plan | 59.95 and 29.95, total 89.90 | 59.95 and 323.46, total 383.41 |
| Senior Dog Wellness Plan | 59.95 and 54.95, total 114.90 | 59.95 and 593.46, total 653.41 |

## Billing day examples (hypothetical enrollment dates)

| Enrollment date | Monthly fee dates that follow |
|---|---|
| 12 April | 12 May, 12 June, 12 July and so on |
| 31 January | 28 February (29 February in a leap year), 31 March, 30 April, 31 May |
| 30 November | 30 December, 30 January, 28 February (29 February in a leap year), 30 March |

A plan enrolled on a hypothetical 12 April has a term that runs 12 months from 12 April.
